# [TASK] ai-service: multi-language Vosk model loading (English + German)

## Task
Extend `SpeechToTextService` to hold and select between English and German
Vosk models by request language.

## Scope
Backend model-loading/selection only. Command parsing changes are Task #4
(#214).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `/speech-to-text` accepts a language parameter (`en`/`de`, case-insensitive), defaulting to English when omitted — `AiController#speechToText` takes an optional `language` request param, `SpeechToTextService#transcribe(audio, language)` normalizes/validates it
- [x] Both models lazy-load independently (requesting English doesn't force-load German and vice versa), same lazy/double-checked-locking pattern as today — `getOrLoadModel` is keyed per language with its own monitor in `loadLocks`, and `transcribe` only ever resolves the single requested language
- [x] Missing model directory for one language doesn't break the other language or ai-service startup, matching the existing fail-mode for the single model today — verified by `SpeechToTextServiceTest`'s independent per-language failure tests
- [x] `infrastructure/scripts/download-vosk-model.sh` (or equivalent) updated to fetch the German model too — rescoped: both the download script and `backend/ai-service/Dockerfile` now fetch and verify both languages' archives (English swapped to `vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph`, German added as `vosk-model-small-de-0.15`, per ADR-021), but the SHA256 checksums pinned for the two new/changed archives are unverified placeholders — this environment has no network egress to `alphacephei.com` to hash the real files (same constraint ADR-021 hit). Tracked as follow-up #229, which must land before #200 closes and merges to `main` (that merge triggers a real Docker image build).
- [x] Unit tests cover both languages' missing-model error path per language, language defaulting/validation/case-normalization, and multi-model `destroy()` cleanup — `SpeechToTextServiceTest` (10 tests) and `AiServiceIntegrationTest`'s new language-passthrough test. Real successful transcription isn't (and wasn't, pre-#212) exercised by these unit tests — that needs the actual downloaded model binaries, same testing philosophy the original single-language suite already established.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Model choice per ADR-021 (`docs/architecture/adr/021-vosk-bilingual-model-selection.md`).

ai-service's k8s memory limits were raised 384Mi/768Mi to 512Mi/1024Mi as a conservative but **unmeasured** buffer for two resident models. ADR-021 asks for real combined-RSS measurement before trusting that headroom — revisit with real numbers. The ADR's fallback (evict-on-switch instead of a limit bump) is still available.

Checksum pinning for the two archives is still open as #229.
